classification.difficultyReason: Apply the four labelled factors to two thirds, then choose four factors independently and multiply both components of three fifths consistently.

content.prompt: Write four equivalent fractions for these fractions.

spec.description: Horizontal five-fraction equality chain with four paired nested multiplication arrows above and below. Each response fraction has an 8 mm dotted numerator and denominator writing blank.
spec.mathematics: Multiply the numerator and denominator of 2/3 by 2, 3, 4 and 5 respectively.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 2/3, equality signs and supplied multipliers are visible; all four response fractions remain blank.
